featured_reviews.name: Sumit Padhiyar
featured_reviews.review_text:
An Incredible Wedding Photographer – Beyond Our Expectations!
Choosing the right photographer for our wedding was one of the most important decisions we had to make, and we are so grateful that we went with Iconic clicks photography.From the very first meeting, they understood our vision and made us feel comfortable, ensuring that every special moment would be captured beautifully.
From the engagement shoot to the wedding day, their professionalism and dedication were truly remarkable. They arrived on time, were well-prepared with all their equipment, and handled every situation with ease. The team was creative in their approach, suggesting unique poses, angles, and lighting techniques that made our photos look straight out of a magazine.
One of the things we loved most was how they captured not just the big moments, but also the candid, emotional, and joyful ones. Every smile, every tear, every laughter-filled moment was documented so beautifully that when we look back at our wedding album, it feels like we are reliving our special day all over again.
The quality of the photos exceeded our expectations. The colors were vibrant, the compositions were stunning, and every little detail was enhanced to perfection. The editing was flawless—subtle yet impactful, making each image look timeless. The wedding album they created for us was nothing short of a masterpiece.

Beyond being a talented photographer. Their calm and friendly demeanor made us feel at ease in front of the camera. They coordinated with our family and friends effortlessly, ensuring that group photos were taken efficiently without any stress.
We were also impressed with how quickly they delivered the photos and videos. The entire process, from shooting to editing to delivery, was seamless. They were responsive to our requests and made sure we were completely satisfied with the final results.

If you are looking for a wedding photographer who truly understands how to capture emotions, create stunning visuals, and deliver top-notch service, look no further than Iconic clicks photography. They turned our dream wedding into a collection of unforgettable memories that we will cherish forever.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5/5) – Highly recommended!

Throughout both events, Sajan and his team were extremely cooperative, patient, and easy to work with. They carried themselves with such professionalism while also bringing a warm and friendly energy that made us feel completely at ease. They never rushed us, never missed a moment, and always made sure we were comfortable. It genuinely felt like having an extended part of our family behind the camera.

What impressed us just as much as their work on the day was their commitment afterward. Every deliverable—from the teaser video, highlights video, to the photo album—was delivered on time, exactly as promised. The photo album, in particular, was of exceptional quality and beautifully captured the essence of our celebrations. The videos were magical, thoughtfully edited, and full of emotion… we’ve watched them more times than we can count.

Sajan’s willingness to cater to all our requests, even the last-minute ones, meant so much to us. His attention to detail and genuine passion for his craft came through in every frame.

Choosing LIVOIVE was one of the best decisions we made for our wedding. We are beyond grateful for the memories they’ve preserved for us, and we would wholeheartedly recommend Sajan and his team to anyone looking for a talented, reliable, and truly dedicated photography and videography team.

Thank you, Sajan and team, for capturing our special days so beautifully and for giving us memories we will cherish forever. 💜📸

featured_reviews.name: Dipanjan De
featured_reviews.review_text:
Please don't, you'll regret going with Santhosh. He's very unprofessional and impolite, and most importantly the output is horrible. Going with him was the worst mistake of our entire wedding.

Firstly, he took the advance and before the shoot, started to insist on picking him from his home and dropping him there. When we refused, he threatened to keep half the money, even though he is the one denying the service. His entire focus was luxury, food and comfort provided to him by us, rather than the shoot itself.

During the shoot he was quite rude. Fought with us multiple times, that too regarding silly things like food and vehicle.

He took almost 45 days to delivery very mediocre videos and 70-80% of the photos he delivered was taken out of the video frames. He never paid any attention to the photos at all.

If we complain about anything, he would say stuff like "reels are complimentary" as mentioned in the package, which he uses to justify garbage level videography. Also, he didn't provide us with Countdown Video, Save the Date Video, and a few more things which he shrugged off as complimentary.

featured_reviews.name: Keyuri Halari
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had Wedding Rollers on board for their services for my brother's wedding. Mr. Viral and his amazing team did such a great job, that I can’t say enough about how professional they are and the quality of work they provide. From the co-ordination of the dates, to event timings, to what shots had to be captured, how much time would be required, etc. everything was discussed well on time before hand, and was very well executed by them. The entire team made everyone so comfortable, captured truly creative snaps, and were always quick and very much punctual. Also they were kind enough to accommodate few of our last moment requirements. Lastly, the deliverables were delivered very well on time.

Overall, I have been so pleased with their services, videos  and final photographs, that I will continue to use their services in the future, as their experience and professionalism very well speaks volumes of their work. I would like to mention this to anyone looking out for photography services, that your search ends here. Highly recommend them!

featured_reviews.name: Rahil Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: If you have enough money to waste and not hire genuine guys please go ahead and do that. As they will promise you the world, but upon delivery they will deliver content that you can even shoot on your mobile phone. They have very poor work ethics and do not live up to their Instagram content. We fell for it, and you may also fall for it. I wish I could put up the video content here show how badly the job was done. No edits, frames were not edited, not focused to the subject, no transitions no affects just a plane raw video, which you have to tell them to edit 1000 times for basic work and some of their google reviews are fake and have been put up by their employee.

featured_reviews.name: himadri makwana
featured_reviews.review_text:
Thankyou for capturing all my wedding events in the best possible manner.

Their team is super cooperative and organized. Photographers and videographers are one of the most important vendors in a wedding as they craft your memories for lifetime and I am so glad I chose Viral and team for the same. From initial discussions to sending them a full excel of event flow to last minute change in plans, they have always taken out time to ensure my points are noted down and executed to the fullest. They become a part of your events just like your family and make sure everyone is comfortable in front of their lens. They are here not just to capture your wedding but to create a long lasting bond with everyone. Their output quality can make any wedding look grand and captivating. The video and photo editing is crisp and engaging. As one of their cinematographer said on my wedding day ‘Jadugar hai hum’ , couldn’t agree more. 💫 Once again, thank you for your efforts team Wedding rollers and thank you for being patient with my manager like follow up messages and calls 😝 Wishing you all the vert best for all your future projects! ♥️ P.S.
